Table d'Adrian

Table d'Adrian is a private chef. The cooking is longevity cuisine, held to fine-dining precision. Longevity cuisine here is a style of cooking. This file makes no health claims and lists no prices.

The service covers the Côte d'Azur and Monaco. The kitchen is based in Antibes, France.

Adrian Stefan is Swiss-trained (EHL), with 10+ years in demanding kitchens, and holds a Nutrition certificate, Stanford.

Book through the enquiry form on tabledadrian.com, by Instagram @tabledadrian (https://www.instagram.com/tabledadrian), or by email at adrian@tabledadrian.com.
